surface: Guest Chat after its configured free AI actions are used
title: Guest allowance refusal appears as a generic permission failure with futile Retry
reproduction: On installed Chrome Web Store 0.2.176, three guest messages succeeded in the same profile. A fourth immediately showed You don't have access to this chat. Sign in and try again, then an interrupted-response Retry.

A read-only live request-log check found the same fingerprint's fourth POST /v2/ai/mandates/extend.browser_chat at 2026-10-03T21:22:57Z returned HTTP 403 after exactly three allowed ai_action log entries. The platform knob auth.guest_ai/free_ai_actions is 3 with no override.

The aidream HTTP contract returns error guest_ai_allowance_used for this boundary. The extension's streamFetch mapped every HTTP 403 to the same generic access message and presentChatStreamError offered Retry for every failure.
expected: The configured guest allowance remains enforced. Once used, Chat accurately explains the limit and points to free signup without offering a retry that must fail again.
actual: Source repair b54877e7 recognizes the exact structured 403 and the documented stream error code, shows a fixed safe allowance message, and suppresses Retry. Other 403 failures keep their generic behavior. Published Store and fresh native acceptance are pending.
severity: S2: guest Chat visibly stops with a misleading access error after the configured allowance
priority: P1: correct a reproducible installed guest failure and its recovery path
evidence: .research/urgent-installed-guest-fourth-20261003.json records valid installed Store UI failure; backend 59f1e995f11d301386cb665af42836664fccee01 was stable before and after.

Live read-only ops.api_request_log and users.guest_execution_log counts matched the HTTP 403 boundary; live platform.feature_knob confirmed the value 3. No guest identifiers, request bodies, or credentials are stored here.

Server owner policy and exact wire shapes: aidream/aidream/api/FEATURE.md guest mode and aidream/packages/matrx-ai/matrx_ai/providers/FEATURE.md. Policy source introduced in aidream 1fe3017a4c (2026-10-02T14:35:59-07:00) and pre-turn refusal updated ac0e7520dc (2026-10-02T14:42:27-07:00); Git history establishes code chronology, not a human attribution or first customer failure.
